children: Japan’s private sector maintained its expansionary path for an 18th consecutive month in September 2026, though overall momentum slowed to its lowest level since May.

The S&P Global Composite PMI Business Activity Index eased to 52.3 from August's 53.5 (and below the flash estimate of 52.5), reflecting broader moderation across both the service and manufacturing sectors.

The S&P Global Services PMI Business Activity Index fell to 51.3 in September, down from 52.5 in August and below the flash reading of 51.6. This marked a result beneath the 2026 year-to-date average.
A softer expansion in new orders, impacted in part by operational disruptions from the Kumamoto earthquake and a continued steep decline in export orders weighed on overall output.
